description: This file defines utility classes for object pooling, specifically the 'Pools' class with nested 'Pool' interface, 'SimplePool', and 'SynchronizedPool' implementations, used to manage object reuse to improve performance in Android applications.

classes.name: Pools
classes.description: Helper class providing object pool implementations for reuse and memory efficiency.

classes.name: Pools.Pool
classes.description: Interface defining methods for acquiring and releasing pooled objects.

classes.name: Pools.SimplePool
classes.description: A non-synchronized implementation of object pool.

classes.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool
classes.description: A thread-safe synchronized implementation of object pool extending 'SimplePool'.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Retrieves an instance from the pool if available.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool for reuse.
